newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's CVNE details IPO share distribution.
newsitem.headline: Spain's CVNE details IPO share distribution.

text.p: Spanish wine producer Compania Vinicola de Norte de Espana (CVNE) has awarded 480,015 shares, or 75 percent, of its initial public offer to retail investors and 160,005, or 25 percent to the institutional investors, stock market watchdog the CNMV said on Tuesday.
In figures presented to the CNMV, the wine producer said the offer had been more than 30 times oversubscribed, with requests for more than 15 million shares and an allocation of 480,015 shares.
CVNE sold 22.46 percent of its capital in an initial public offering.
